infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nurture uses the camera only when you tap the camera button, to take bump and scan photos you choose to save.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nurture accesses your photo library only when you choose a photo to attach to your story.

plugins.microphonePermission: Nurture uses the microphone only when you tap the mic button, to turn your words into a draft you review before saving.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Nurture turns your dictated words into a draft you review before saving. Audio stays on this device when the device supports it.
